newsitem.title: GERMANY: British Harrier crashes in Germany, pilot safe.
newsitem.headline: British Harrier crashes in Germany, pilot safe.

text.p: A British fighter pilot ejected from his Harrier GR 7 jump jet as it crashed on the runway at its home base in Germany on Thursday, the Royal Air Force (RAF) said.
It said the pilot broke his leg in the incident at the Laarbruch airbase on the German-Dutch border, but no one else was hurt. The Harrier had no weapons on board at the time, it added.
Two British air force Tornado jets crashed in Germany last year, the crews managing to eject safely. Britain's opposition Labour party demanded an inquiry.
The RAF said it was investigating the cause of the latest crash.
